purpose: A52 original official Jekyll image no-egress build wrapper; outer workflow inverse only; not executed

.github/workflows/pages-package-validati.before:
name: Pages package validation
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '_config.yml'
      - 'farm3d/**'
      - '.github/workflows/pages-package-validation.yml'
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: pages-package-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  package:
    name: Pages-compatible build and runtime package
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - name: Fetch immutable evidence baseline
        run: git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 2f9a8241b8230938dd816e1c0fac52551a263f69
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Verify source contract and deliberate failure controls
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/a52-ci-safe/package"
          node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/farm3d/tests/helpers/ci-isolated-runner.cjs" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/a52-ci-safe/package/step-1.json" --timeout-ms 900000 --max-output-bytes 16777216 -- bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail -c 'node farm3d/tests/pages-package.verify.cjs --source-only'
      - name: Build using the official GitHub Pages toolchain
        uses: actions/jekyll-build-pages@44a6e6beabd48582f863aeeb6cb2151cc1716697 # v1
        with:
          source: ./
          destination: ./_site
          build_revision: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: Verify actual output, game bytes and dependency paths
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/a52-ci-safe/package"
          node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/farm3d/tests/helpers/ci-isolated-runner.cjs" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/a52-ci-safe/package/step-2.json" --timeout-ms 900000 --max-output-bytes 16777216 -- bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail -c 'node farm3d/tests/pages-package.verify.cjs --output _site --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/pages-package.json"'
      - name: Retain small package receipt
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: pages-package-${{ github.run_attempt }}-execution-receipts-only
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/a52-ci-safe/package/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
